This is a real, verifiable minor defect introduced by the new dialog code.

record.issue_text: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `message` is always a non-empty template string, making the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback dead code and exposing raw error codes to users

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the error handler builds `message` using a template literal: `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`. A template literal always produces a string, even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined` (it becomes the text "undefined") and even if the translation is empty, so `message` will still be truthy (e.g., "undefined: "). Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never use the fallback, making it dead code. The constructed message also directly includes `err.data?.code` (a raw TRPC error code like `BAD_REQUEST`, `FORBIDDEN`), which will be shown to users.
